events.title: Geoffrey Hinton's team wins ImageNet with AlexNet
events.summary: Geoffrey Hinton's students Krizhevsky, Sutskever, and Hinton won ImageNet 2012 with AlexNet — triggering the deep learning revolution.
events.about: AlexNet's GPU-trained convolutional network crushed traditional computer vision pipelines — convincing Google, Facebook, and industry to bet on neural networks. Hinton had pursued backprop for decades before this breakthrough.

narrative.whyChosen: AlexNet was the inflection point for modern deep learning adoption.
narrative.whyImportant: It proved neural networks could beat hand-engineered vision features at scale.
narrative.problemSolved: Computer vision relied on brittle handcrafted features that did not generalize.
